# VELOCITY X — Cyber Highway Police Pursuit

> Next-generation 3D WebGL hypercar highway racing and tactical police pursuit progressive web application (PWA) engineered with Three.js r160, React 18, TypeScript, and procedural Web Audio API.

## Quick Links

- [Play Velocity X Online](https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/VELOCITY-X/)
- [Project Documentation](https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/VELOCITY-X)
- [XML Sitemap](https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/VELOCITY-X/sitemap.xml)
- [Web Application Manifest](https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/VELOCITY-X/manifest.json)
- [Full LLM Context](https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/VELOCITY-X/llms-full.txt)

## Overview & Capabilities

VELOCITY X is a high-performance web game delivering console-quality 60–120 FPS arcade racing directly in modern desktop and mobile web browsers without plugins or downloads.

- **Offline-First PWA**: Fully functional in Airplane Mode via Service Worker caching with automated Over-The-Air (OTA) updates.
- **Procedural 3D Environment**: Infinite highway generation with dynamic traffic AI, procedural skyline silhouettes, dynamic day/night lighting, and real-time weather effects (rain, lightning, wet road specular sheen).
- **Zero Asset Audio**: 100% real-time procedural audio synthesis using the Web Audio API with zero external MP3/WAV download overhead.
- **Dual Platform Input**: Full desktop keyboard controls (WASD, Arrows, Shift, Space, M, C) and mobile multi-touch HUD controls with gyroscope tilt-to-steer support.

## Interactive Controls & Hotkeys

Autonomous agents and human operators can interact with the game via standard keyboard events and pointer gestures:

- `W` or `ArrowUp`: Throttle / Accelerate
- `S` or `ArrowDown` or `Space`: Brake / Decelerate
- `A` or `ArrowLeft`: Steer Left
- `D` or `ArrowRight`: Steer Right
- `Shift`: Activate Nitro Boost (NOS)
- `M`: Toggle Sound Mute
- `C`: Toggle Dynamic Weather (Tokyo Rainstorm / Clear Sky)
- `Enter` or `Pointer Tap`: Start Quick Race from Splash Screen

## Game Modes & Garage System

1. **Highway Pursuit Mode**: High-speed traffic evasion with aggressive police interceptors deploying PIT maneuvers, spike strips, and road barriers.
2. **Track Select**:
   - `NEON HIGHWAY (NIGHT)`: Cyberpunk metropolitan skyline, neon reflections, and wet asphalt sheen.
   - `PACIFIC COAST (DAY)`: High-noon sun, crisp shadows, and coastal horizon lighting.
3. **Hypercar Showroom**:
   - Multiple unlockable hypercars with distinctive top speed, handling, and acceleration curves.
   - Custom automotive paint finishes and neon underglow customization.

## Technical Architecture

- **Rendering Engine**: Three.js r160 WebGL 2.0 with ACES Filmic tone mapping, PCF soft shadows, and UnrealBloom post-processing.
- **Frontend Stack**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 5, Vanilla CSS with hardware-accelerated transform layers.
- **Performance Budget**: Initial load bundle under 80 KB gzipped, Total Blocking Time (TBT) of 0ms, and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) under 0.03.
- **Accessibility & Compliance**: 100/100 WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility tree with full semantic landmarks, descriptive ARIA attributes, and accessible name matching.
